integrity: Exact finite-state and conditional-variance checks accompany a self-contained martingale proof. Finite checks are not an infinite process proof.
scientific_limitations: Two colors, positive integral reinforcement with \(a<3b\) and equal deterministic total additions; fixed initial composition; row-constant \(p_N\) at logarithmic distance from the critical point. No rates or unequal-total replacement. Historical priority requires independent assessment.
title: The logarithmic Ornstein–Uhlenbeck window for a fixed-increment Friedman–Pólya urn
